Class IdentitySelectionService

java.lang.Object
swiss.trustbroker.profileselection.service.IdentitySelectionService
All Implemented Interfaces:
swiss.trustbroker.api.profileselection.service.ProfileSelectionService
Direct Known Subclasses:
LdapIdentitySelectionService, RestIdentitySelectionService
public abstract class IdentitySelectionService extends Object implements swiss.trustbroker.api.profileselection.service.ProfileSelectionService
Abstract base class for Identity Selection (LDAP and REST). Extracts common profile selection logic.
